newsitem.title: USA: SS&C Tech sees Q3 results below estimates.
newsitem.headline: SS&C Tech sees Q3 results below estimates.

text.p: SS&C Technologies Inc said Friday it expects third quarter revenue and earnings to fall short of analysts' estimates.
The company said it expects a loss of $0.02 to $0.04 per share for the quarter and expects revenues of about $6 million.
First Call estimates put third quarter earnings at a profit of $0.07 per share. The company said it lost $0.01 a share in the year-earlier period.
SS&C said third quarter revenues of $6 million would represent a 22 percent increase from a year earlier.

The company blamed delays in new product releases, continued difficulty in shortening the contracting process, and lower than expected growth in its outsourcing business, which contributed to slower than expected sales.
It said it will report third quarter results on October 31.
